title: Prices and price ratings cut off on every car
symptom: Each price is clipped to a box four characters wide ("£10,", "£14,") and each price-rating line to 136 px, so the full price and the amount above or below average cannot be read on any listing.
css:
.car__price { width: 4ch; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; }
.car__rating { flex-wrap: nowrap; width: 136px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; }
